arxiv-2106-00480.title: Design of Placement Delivery Arrays for Coded Caching with Small Subpacketizations and Flexible Memory Sizes
arxiv-2106-00480.creator: Xianzhang Wu, Minquan Cheng, Congduan Li, Member, IEEE, Li Chen, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2106-00480.description: Abstract Coded caching is an emerging technique to reduce the data transmission load during the peak-traffic times. In such a scheme, each file in the data center or library is usually divided into a number of packets to pursue a low broadcasting rate based on the designed placements at each user’s cache.

arxiv-2107-13269.title: Aug3D-RPN: Improving Monocular 3D Object Detection by Synthetic Images with Virtual Depth
arxiv-2107-13269.creator: Chenhang He, Jianqiang Huang, Xian-Sheng Hua, Lei Zhang {csche}@comp.polyu.edu.hk, jianqiang.hjq@alibaba-inc.comhuaxiansheng@gmail.com, cslzhang@comp.polyu.edu.hk
arxiv-2107-13269.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Chenhang He, Jianqiang Huang, Xian-Sheng Hua, Lei Zhang {csche}@comp.polyu.edu.hk, jianqiang.hjq@alibaba-inc.comhuaxiansheng@gmail.com, cslzhang@comp.polyu.edu.hk. Current geometry-based monocular 3D object detection models can efficiently detect objects by leveraging perspective geometry, but their performance is limited due to the absence of accurate depth information. Though this issue can be alleviated in a depth-based model where a depth estimation module is plugged to predict depth information before 3D box reasoning, the introduction of such module dramatically reduces the detection speed.

arxiv-2111-08026.title: Energy magnetization and transport in systems with a non-zero Berry curvature in a magnetic field
arxiv-2111-08026.creator: Archisman Panigrahi, Subroto Mukerjee
arxiv-2111-08026.description: Abstract We demonstrate that the well-known expression for the charge magnetization of a sample with a non-zero Berry curvature can be obtained by demanding that the Einstein relation holds for the electric transport current. We extend this formalism to the transport energy current and show that the energy magnetization must satisfy a particular condition.

arxiv-2201-01779.title: Controllable Nonreciprocal Optical Response and Handedness-Switching in Magnetized Spin-Orbit Coupled Graphene
arxiv-2201-01779.creator: Mohammad Alidoust, Klaus Halterman
arxiv-2201-01779.description: Abstract Starting from a low-energy effective Hamiltonian model, we theoretically calculate the dynamical optical conductivity and permittivity tensor of a magnetized graphene layer with Rashba spin-orbit coupling (SOC). Our results reveal a transverse Hall conductivity correlated with the nonreciprocal longitudinal conductivity.

arxiv-2201-06165.title: Bounding conjugacy depth functions for wreath products of finitely generated abelian groups The first author is currently support by the Australian Research Council Laureate Fellowship FL170100032 of Professor George Willis. The second author is partially supported by NSF grant DMS-1812028 “Geometry
arxiv-2201-06165.creator: Michal Ferov, Mark Pengitore
arxiv-2201-06165.description: Abstract In this article, we study the asymptotic behaviour of conjugacy separability for wreath products of abelian groups. We fully characterise the asymptotic class in the case of lamplighter groups and give exponential upper and lower bounds for generalised lamplighter groups. In the case where the base group is infinite, we give superexponential lower and upper bounds.

arxiv-2407-18672.title: Gluonic Hidden-charm Tetraquark States
arxiv-2407-18672.creator: Bing-Dong Wan 1,2 and Shuo Yang 1,2
arxiv-2407-18672.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Bing-Dong Wan 1,2 and Shuo Yang 1,2. In this paper, a new type of hybrid state, which consists of two valence quarks and two valence antiquarks together with a valence gluon, the gluonic tetraquark states, are investigated.

arxiv-2408-01505.title: MoDE: Effective Multi-task Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning with a Mixture of Dyadic Experts
arxiv-2408-01505.creator: Lin Ning, Harsh Lara, Meiqi Guo, Abhinav Rastogi
arxiv-2408-01505.description: Abstract Parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) have revolutionized the adaptation of large language models (LLMs) to diverse tasks. Recent efforts have explored mixtures of LoRA modules for multi-task settings. However, our analysis reveals redundancy in the down-projection matrices of these architectures.

arxiv-2506-02943.title: Hallucination to Consensus: Multi-Agent LLMs for End-to-End Test Generation with Accurate Oracles
arxiv-2506-02943.creator: Qinghua Xu, Guancheng Wang, Lionel C. Briand, Kui Liu
arxiv-2506-02943.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Qinghua Xu, Guancheng Wang, Lionel C. Briand, Kui Liu. Unit testing plays a critical role in ensuring software correctness. However, writing unit tests manually is labor-intensive, especially for strong typed languages like Java, motivating the need for automated approaches. Traditional methods primarily rely on search-based or randomized algorithms to generate tests that achieve high code coverage and produce regression oracles, which are assertions derived from the program’s current behavior rather than its intended functionality.

arxiv-2506-08439.title: Discovery of Odd Radio Circles and Other Peculiars in the First Year of the EMU Survey using Object Detection
arxiv-2506-08439.creator: Nikhel Gupta 1, Ray P. Norris 2,3, Zeeshan Hayder 4, Minh Huynh 1,5, Heinz Andernach 6, Andrew M. Hopkins 7, Stanislav Shabala 8, Lawrence Rudnick 9, Miroslav D. Filipović 2, Bärbel S. Koribalski 3,2, Lars Petersson 4, X. Rosalind Wang 2
arxiv-2506-08439.description: Abstract We present a systematic search for Odd Radio Circles (ORCs) and other unusual radio morphologies using data from the first year of the EMU (Evolutionary Map of the Universe) survey. ORCs are rare, enigmatic objects characterized by edge-brightened rings of radio emission, often found in association with distant galaxies.

arxiv-2507-16015.title: Is Tracking really more challenging in First Person Egocentric Vision?
arxiv-2507-16015.creator: Matteo Dunnhofer, Zaira Manigrasso, Christian Micheloni
arxiv-2507-16015.description: Abstract Visual object tracking and segmentation are becoming fundamental tasks for understanding human activities in egocentric vision. Recent research has benchmarked state-of-the-art methods and concluded that first person egocentric vision presents challenges compared to previously studied domains. However, these claims are based on evaluations conducted across significantly different scenarios.

pmc-10583250.title: Optimized infusion rates for N,N‐dimethyltryptamine to achieve a target psychedelic intensity based on a modeling and simulation framework
pmc-10583250.creator: Emma Eckernäs, Jeroen Koomen, Christopher Timmermann, Robin Carhart‐Harris, Daniel Röshammar, Michael Ashton
pmc-10583250.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). N,N‐dimethyltryptamine (DMT) is a psychedelic compound that is being studied as a therapeutic option in various psychiatric disorders. Due to its short half‐life, continuous infusion of DMT has been proposed to extend the psychedelic experience and potential therapeutic effects. The primary aim of this work was to design an infusion protocol for DMT based on a desired level of psychedelic intensity using population pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic modeling.

pmc-11738026.title: Acute Kidney Injury Survivor Remote Patient Monitoring: A Single Center’s Experience and an Effectiveness Evaluation

pmc-12603510.title: Learning curve and outcomes of young surgeons in uniportal video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery lobectomy using bent-tip thoracoscopic forceps for lung cancer
pmc-12603510.creator: Yasushi Mizukami, Yoshiki Chiba, Kazuki Sato, Yasuyuki Nakamura, Wataru Arai, Ryunosuke Maki, Hirofumi Adachi
pmc-12603510.description: BackgroundUniportal video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) is gaining popularity but may pose technical challenges for young surgeons in maintaining surgical precision compared to conventional multiportal VATS. This study assessed perioperative outcomes and lymph node dissection between uniportal VATS lobectomy using bent-tip thoracoscopic forceps to keep surgical precision and conventional multiportal VATS lobectomy for lung carcinoma.

pmc-13402828.title: Nondestructive removal of superhydrophobic coatings by an electric switch
pmc-13402828.creator: Shuangyan Huang, Qilin Yue, Jiahao Lv, Yanan Wang, Hailei Yang, Qisheng He, Jianwen Zhang, Yong Wei, Shanlin Wang
pmc-13402828.description: Extensive efforts have been made to enhance the durability of superhydrophobic coatings by adhesives, yet it raises a challenge to nondestructively remove the failed coatings. Here, we propose a nondestructively removable superhydrophobic (NRS) coating by an electrical switch, inspired by the nondestructive ecdysis of snakes.

pmc-13490531.creator: Rahim Rostami, Jamileh Jahanbakhsh, Shirin Salehi, Katayoon Asgari, Soudabeh Fallah
pmc-13490531.description: Recurrent implantation failure (RIF) is a major challenge in reproductive medicine. This study explores the expression profiles and interactions of progesterone receptor B (PGR-B), prokineticin 1 (PROK1), prokineticin receptor 1 (PROKR1), and their regulatory associations with microRNA-210-5p (miR-210-5p) and long non-coding RNA H19 (lncRNA-H19) within endometrial tissue.

pmc-13564492.creator: Chaeheon Lee, Young Jae Kim, Han-song Song, Soohyun Oh, Kwang Gi Kim
pmc-13564492.description: Background: Abnormal uterine bleeding (AUB) caused by adenomyosis can result in significant iron-deficiency anemia. Given that transvaginal ultrasound (TVUS) is commonly performed during routine examinations, its assessment may facilitate preemptive treatment. Methods: In this study, TVUS images from patients with surgically confirmed adenomyosis were preprocessed to minimize intra- and inter-scan variability.

uslaw-usc-t41-s111.title: 41 U.S.C. § 111 — Procurement
uslaw-usc-t41-s111.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t41-s111.description: United States Code, Title 41 (Public Contracts); Chapter 1 (Definitions); Subchapter I (Subtitle Definitions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this subtitle, the term “procurement” includes all stages of the process of acquiring property or services, beginning with the process for determining a need for property or services and ending with contract completion and closeout.
